title: Valid ListInterfaces discovery request
purpose: Exercise a separate discovery command entry point with the same valid empty-header form to broaden command coverage beyond ListServices.
expected_behavior: Parser should recognize ListInterfaces with zero data length and process it as a valid discovery request independent of prior session registration.
